defects.description: Invoice rounds individual quotes before summing instead of rounding the aggregate microcredit amount.

trigger.input: node --input-type=module -e 'import {Session} from "./src/session.js"; const s=new Session().register("cpu",400); s.add("cpu",1); s.add("cpu",1); console.log(s.checkout("a").credits);'

defects.why_missed: S9(d): the tempting oracle sums rounded line credits, but settlement is rounded once for the whole invoice; integral-rate checkout tests cannot distinguish them.

defects.description: Summary narrows a safe integer credit total to a signed 32-bit integer.

trigger.input: node --input-type=module -e 'import {Ledger} from "./src/ledger.js"; import {summarize} from "./src/report.js"; const l=new Ledger(); l.post({reference:"a",credits:3000000000}); console.log(summarize(l).credits);'

defects.why_missed: S9(b): a three-billion-credit balance crosses the signed word range; small reports and individual entry checks stay correct.
